ingram.files: data/{FB-25,FB-50,FB-75,FB-100,WK-50,WK-100}/{msg,valid,test}.txt (= inference_graph, inf_valid, inf_test in ULTRA's raw directory)
ingram.checks: git blob hash of all 18 files equals the InGram tree at the commit; sha256 of all 18 files equals that of the raw files on the GPU server

mapping_page_parse.row_regex: convert/lib.php getPropertyMapping, applied to the text before '(/key/ namespace)'

conventions.graph_keys: the runner keys InGram FB-<v> as ifb-<v> and InGram WK-<v> as wk-<v>; versions in present_in, active_in and per_version are <v>
conventions.vocabulary: a graph's relations are those of its inference graph, validation and test triples, numbered in that order of first appearance, as ULTRA's InGram loader numbers them
conventions.reverse: true when head and tail of the triple must be swapped to align with the target property's direction
conventions.keep: the merged relation takes the keep member's label and the keep member's native direction

keep_rule.ifb: member with the most inference-graph triples summed over FB-25, FB-50, FB-75 and FB-100; ties to the smallest relation string
keep_rule.wk: member with the most inference-graph triples summed over WK-50 and WK-100; ties to the lowest property number

conventions.relabel: on a graph where a group is active, every triple (h, m, t) of a member m in the graph's vocabulary becomes (h, keep, t), or (t, keep, h) when swap_head_tail_when_relabelling_to_keep is true; duplicates in the inference graph are dropped
conventions.present: the relation has at least one triple in the graph's inference graph (msg.txt = inference_graph)
conventions.active_group: a group is applied to a graph only when at least two of its members are present there; listed per graph in active_in

rules.A: the Wikidata image is a main-value statement: A1 direct row, A2 empty row annotated 'reverse of' a mapped property, A3 CVT link and CVT main property share one property (converter CVT rule, incl. its ITEM and SPOUSE special cases), A4 path that reverses a CVT main property and ends on the CVT's back-link to the statement's subject (the CVT property named after the subject's type)
rules.B: CVT path whose object becomes a qualifier of the subject's statement (link property -> property, CVT property -> qualifier)

conventions.yago_mapping: a WK group is a set of Wikidata properties that the YAGO 4.5 shapes map to one YAGO property and to no other; YAGO keeps the Wikidata direction, so no member is reversed
conventions.yago_class_scope: YAGO attaches each mapping to node shapes (classes, listed per member as yago_shapes); the WK graphs have no entity types, so the relabelling applies each mapping to every triple of the property, whatever the subject's class
conventions.profile: 8 integers per relation node of ULTRA's relation graph built from the inference graph with inverse relations: out-degree for h2h, t2t, h2t, t2h, then in-degree in the same order; self-loops count; a relation without inference edges has the zero profile
conventions.displacement_L1: L1 distance between a member's node profile in the original inference graph, taken in the kept member's direction, and the merged relation's node profile in the merged inference graph
conventions.strata: merged = target relation is a member of an applied group; profile_shifted = other relation whose node profile (either direction) changed; profile_identical = the rest
conventions.absorbed: test targets that, after relabelling, coincide with a triple of the merged inference graph; dropped from both evaluations
conventions.tiers_evaluated: tier sizes among affected targets that are not absorbed, the target counts the analysis compares with the severity threshold
conventions.severity_comparable: high and low tiers_evaluated each hold at least 10 targets
conventions.filter: merged inference graph + merged validation triples + merged test triples
